facts.fact: In the AUSIM white paper the delegate minister for digital transition says her ministry carries a Feuille de Route Cloud 2025-2030 of six objectives and 21 domains and is putting in place a public-sector 'Cloud First' policy, while the roadmap itself is described as not yet published, with a national reference architecture still to be defined from 2026; the document gives no adoption date.
